_comment: Which skills ship in the Claude Code and Codex plugin (plugins/memrain/skills, one folder both hosts read), which stay on the host, which the plugin leaves out for another reason, and which are offered as MCP prompts. Every skill in deploy/skills sits in exactly one of plugin, operator_only and excluded, with its reason. A plugin skill names no operator-only tool and hands off only to skills the plugin ships. scripts/generate-plugin-tree.ts copies the plugin lane out of deploy/skills; tests/skillpack_plugin_tree.test.ts fails when the copies drift or a lane rule breaks.

plugin.query: the core retrieval loop every session uses
plugin.capture: saving a thought or link is the write half of the core loop
plugin.brain-ops: day-to-day reads and writes a client agent performs constantly
plugin.briefing: a daily view a client asks for by name
plugin.correction-pipeline: user corrections become durable brain updates instead of session-local fixes
plugin.connect-client: the plugin's own setup and verification path
plugin.fact-check: checks a client's draft claim by claim with read-only brain tools
plugin.research-compendium: deep research a client runs from chat, filed under research/
plugin.draft-in-voice: ghostwriting from a validated profile; drafts only, never sends
plugin.resolve-before-asking: stops a client asking the user what the brain already knows
plugin.brain-link-discipline: every page a client reports carries a working link
plugin.media-ingest: capture hands bulk and media ingestion to it; page writes a client already makes
plugin.idea-ingest: capture hands an article or link with author metadata to it
plugin.meeting-ingestion: capture hands a meeting transcript to it for attendee enrichment
plugin.academic-verify: traces a claim to its source with the client's own web search, then files the verdict
plugin.article-enrichment: turns a raw article dump into a structured page with page writes a client already makes
plugin.ask-user: the shared decision-point pattern other plugin skills gate on
plugin.blog-ingest: imports a whole blog or feed through the client's own fetch tools
plugin.book-mirror: a per-chapter reading a client runs on a book the user hands it
plugin.bulk-ingestion: the trial-then-bulk discipline for any large import a client drives
plugin.chat-connectors: keeps the client's own Claude Code and Codex sessions flowing into the brain
plugin.citation-fixer: fixes citation format on pages with ordinary page edits
plugin.citation-graph-ingest: types the references between ingested documents with read and link tools
plugin.daily-task-manager: the user's task list as one version-checked page a client edits by request
plugin.daily-task-prep: morning prep a client asks for by name; extends briefing
plugin.data-loss-gate: the confirmation gate before a client deletes, forgets or strips brain data
plugin.ingest: routes new content to the ingestion skills the plugin ships
plugin.ingest-gate: entity and duplicate check before a client writes a new page
plugin.mail-loops: replies owed and awaited, read and closed over MCP from chat
plugin.repo-architecture: where a new page goes; every writing skill defers to it
plugin.reports: saves and finds timestamped reports and checks their links before the user sees them

operator_only.db-repair: diagnoses the host's database; needs host access and operator tools
operator_only.install: first install of the server on a host
operator_only.brain-upgrade: upgrades the server on its host
operator_only.minion-orchestrator: the durable job queue is operator-only
operator_only.postgres-adopt: moves the host's engine; host access and a reviewed plan
operator_only.remote-mcp: changes the host's reach and mints credentials
operator_only.mcp-access: owner administration of clients and grants
operator_only.skill-optimizer: paid, capped routing evaluation run by hand on the host
operator_only.skill-autobench: feeds the maintainer's benchmark files; reads the host's friction log
operator_only.skillpack-harvest: edits the shipped pack in the repository
operator_only.company-brainify: builds a team source and its grants; operator standing required
operator_only.schema-unify: retypes pages in bulk with a host command
operator_only.advisor: runs the operator-only advisor tool on a cadence
operator_only.cold-start: bootstraps a new brain with operator job and doctor tools
operator_only.maintain: brain health sweeps through operator job, stats and doctor tools
operator_only.measure-before-you-fix: triages host alerts with operator job and doctor tools
operator_only.cron-scheduler: schedules recurring work on the host with operator job tools
operator_only.eiirp: post-work filing audit built on the operator-only doctor
operator_only.frontmatter-guard: repairs frontmatter through the operator-only doctor
operator_only.brain-taxonomist: owner taxonomy work that reads the operator-only doctor
operator_only.schema-author: evolves the brain's type taxonomy; owner work using operator stats
operator_only.enrich: tiered entity enrichment that submits operator-only background jobs
operator_only.concept-synthesis: rebuilds the concept map through the operator-only concept listing
operator_only.testing: runs the repository's test suite and the operator-only doctor
operator_only.smoke-test: post-restart checks of the server environment on its host
operator_only.skillpack-check: install health verdict from the operator-only doctor and status
operator_only.migrate: bulk migration from other note tools, checked with operator stats and doctor
operator_only.setup: provisions the server, its database and first import on a host
operator_only.skillify: authors and lints skills in the repository's deploy/skills
operator_only.skill-creator: writes new skills and resolver rows in the repository
operator_only.share-audit: operator review of what a proposed team grant would expose

excluded.soul-audit: rewrites the brain's identity pages through an owner interview; not a task for every client
excluded.context-audit: owner token-hygiene review whose follow-ups route to operator skills
excluded.publish: exports private pages outside the brain; kept out of the default client install (get_skill still serves it)
excluded.conversation-archive: imports exports and repairs the archive with memrain commands run where the brain's data lives; chat-connectors is the client half
excluded.webhook-transforms: needs an inbound endpoint the operator exposes on the host
excluded.two-tier-extraction: paid multi-model corpus runs charged to the brain's spend wallet under an owner-set cap
excluded.signal-detector: fires on every inbound message, which needs a harness hook the plugin does not install
excluded.functional-area-resolver: rewrites an agent's routing file; harness authoring, not brain use
excluded.voice-note-ingest: links tosignal-detector, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.archive-crawler: links tovoice-note-ingest, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.data-research: links tocron-scheduler for its recurring runs, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.perplexity-research: links todata-research and enrich, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.strategic-reading: links tobrain-pdf and perplexity-research, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.brain-pdf: links topublish, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.idea-lineage: links toconcept-synthesis, which the plugin does not ship
excluded.cross-modal-review: links totesting, which the plugin does not ship; still served as an MCP prompt
